title: Clause count of a tree-derived CNF
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ Boolean coordinates whose leaves are labeled by signs in $\{\pm1\}$. The number of clauses in the CNF formula associated with $T$ is at most the number of leaves of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: A decision tree on $n$ Boolean coordinates with sign-valued leaves
